fields.description:
1.0: Excellent - On zone line
0.9: Very Good - High precision
0.8: Good - Within accuracy range
0.7: Acceptable - Within buffer
0.5: Fair - Near buffer edge
0.3: Poor - May need verification
0.1: Very Poor - Manual review required

fields.description: Metres from the recorded point to the chosen zone. Meaningless unless Zone Verification is Verified or Far — a Float cannot hold 'no reading', so it stores 0 for No Fix and No Geometry. Always read the two together.
